Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
document outlines the testing procedure P1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The YTM 
7111 relay are designed to bring generator out of service when a field loss is 
detected by the relay and the phase currents on phases R&T of generator stator 
circuit exceed a pre - determined setting
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel Morred, accepted by general director eng. Nagy Nageeb Saleh and approved 
by eng. Khalaf Allah Mahmoud Abd El-Gaber head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) 
Hydraulic 
Power Stations and certified by eng. Mohamed Usama Soliman HPGC MPIS 
Coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued.
Maintenance staff should carry the ID Safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained qualified or directly supervised by 
 some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Personal protective equipment must be used as safety helmet, safety 
 shoes ... etc
The 
 generator must be isolated.
Switch off the DC power supply before inserting or withdrawing the relay.

the tripping element

unit should operate to trip the circuit breaker and signaling an alarm.
